approvals.scope: Two coupled scope items arising from TASK-0004. First, name baseline candidates in docs/research/BENCHMARK_CONTRACT.md and add two comparison arms (an LLM-orchestrated agentic planner over the same operator vocabulary, and a fixed-route-set conditional model). Second, reframe the Research Track contribution claim from a mechanism claim to a composite plus evaluation contribution, since the per-case typed dynamic DAG pattern is published prior art.
approvals.rationale: CLAUDE.md puts materially changing public benchmark rules and materially changing claims behind human approval. Wave 1 of the literature survey established both are now required by the evidence. The first entry in an approvals file that has been empty since the project began.
risks: Adding two comparison arms raises the compute budget against an unresolved RISK-0004
Reframing the contribution narrows what the Proposal may claim and may read as a weaker project to an examiner
Not reframing is worse: a first-person novelty sentence about per-case typed DAGs would be false as written
safeguards: Every claim traces to a LIT- identifier verified against a primary source
Twelve novelty threats are tabulated with the experiment that would settle each
reviewed_by is null on every record until TASK-0026 signs off
No baseline family leaves DEFERRED until SRCH-0006 reports licence and reproducibility

limits.applies_to: docs/research/BENCHMARK_CONTRACT.md and the Research Track contribution claim
limits.does_not_authorize: selecting a dataset, choosing a base model, adopting a triage taxonomy, or any training run

approvals.rollback: Both items are document changes. Reverting means restoring the six abstract comparison families and the prior claim wording; no data, weights or artifacts are affected.

approvals.scope: Commit the project to one named care setting and propagate it. DEC-0016 fixes the evaluated setting as the first-contact triage station of a hospital emergency department, adults 18+, self-presenting, non-trauma, non-obstetric, not arriving by ambulance, with two evaluated decision moments (T0 at triage completion, T1 at 60-90 minutes). Propagation touches PROJECT_CHARTER.md, PRODUCT_SPEC.md, CLINICAL_WORKFLOW.md, SAFETY_SPEC.md, DATA_CONTRACT.md, BENCHMARK_CONTRACT.md and RESEARCH_SPEC.md; adds a required care_setting object to schemas/dataset-feasibility.schema.json with all seven datasets backfilled; and rebuilds the frozen evaluation case set so it exercises all four urgency levels and one T1 snapshot.
approvals.rationale: CLAUDE.md puts materially changing scope, claims and success criteria behind human approval. Naming the evaluated setting fixes what under-triage measures, what the Proposal may claim, and which dataset the project must obtain. It also supplies the missing half of APR-0001: that approval reframes the contribution as an evaluation contribution in a domain the field has not entered, and the domain is undefined until this decision is accepted.
risks: The surveyed data does not cover the chosen setting. MIMIC-IV records hosp and icu; MIMIC-IV-ED has never been surveyed, so CHIEF_COMPLAINT and TRIAGE_NOTE have no recorded data source (RISK-0014)
Staying on MIMIC accepts novelty threats T5 (LIT-0036) and T6 (LIT-0025) rather than dodging them
Rebuilding the frozen case set changes the reported escalation rate of 0.83; a lower number could be misread as a safety improvement when it is a property of the new case set
Naming an emergency-department setting invites the assumption that a triage scale has been adopted, when no licence permits adopting one
safeguards: The four abstract urgency levels are unchanged and CLINICAL_WORKFLOW.md's prohibition on mapping to a real operational triage scale stays in force verbatim
RISK-0014 is raised at the same time as the decision, not after it
If MIMIC-IV-ED is not surveyed as DS-0008 by 2 October, the Proposal states the setting as the intended evaluation setting with the survey outstanding, and does not present it as data-backed
The prior EVAL-0001 record is preserved; the rebuilt case set is recorded as a new evaluation, and the escalation change is reported as a case-set property
tests/fixtures/cases/README.md keeps its label that expectations are author-declared and not clinical ground truth
Thanrada Tungweerapornpong owns the case-set rebuild; the Product owner does not author the cases that grade her own service

limits.applies_to: The evaluated care setting, the documents and schemas listed in scope, and the frozen evaluation case set
limits.does_not_authorize: adopting ESI, CTAS, MTS, ATS, KTAS, JTAS or the Thai national triage scale; obtaining or accessing MIMIC-IV-ED; editing the signed docs/academic/PROJECT_IDEA.md; any change to the Model API Contract urgency semantics; any training run

approvals.rollback: Every item is a document, schema or fixture change. Reverting means restoring the deferred setting language in CLINICAL_WORKFLOW.md, dropping the care_setting field and its harness checks, and restoring the twelve-case fixture set. No data, weights or artifacts are affected.
